## Batch 104 complete

Authored the toric-code definition, ground-space theorem, local Pauli centralizer lemma, string and local-test theorem, and defect-pair example. The centralizer lemma is an added local prerequisite, with a complete finite proof. Both assigned pages are in place.

All five Step 1 records currently report **ready**. Dependency levels are 0 for the definition, 1 for the ground-space theorem and centralizer lemma, 2 for the string theorem, and 3 for the example. The readiness records do not constitute independent proof approval.

The work uses two inspected full-text treatments: [Kitaev](https://arxiv.org/pdf/quant-ph/9707021) and [Preskill’s lecture notes](https://www.preskill.caltech.edu/ph219/topological.pdf). Source evidence, coverage, proof contracts, dependency edges, and notes are recorded in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-104.notes.md>) and [source reading record](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-104-sources/source-reading.md>). The notes record the plan-spec difference: its item arrays are empty, while the design specifies an inventory.

Scoped content, dependency, rendering, precheck, proof-layout, contract, coverage, and source-fetch checks passed. Three run-wide checks remain blocked by unrelated work: the dependency-level check encounters 37 other empty inventories; the batch-level snapshot is stale pending the drained authoring join; and full-run proof-contract coverage encounters an empty `qsmx-quantum-double` inventory. No shared plan or run-wide state was changed.
